setup-v3-dark.svg: Install: npm install vlm-code-context-mcp. Zero API keys. One context.db file. Two entry points: code-context is the code index (6 tools, the default). code-context-sprint adds the sprint process and the dashboard on the same database. Initialize: npx code-context-mcp setup . creates context.db, indexes your codebase and installs code-context-sprint. It seeds a 9-agent team and the frontend skill library into the project database. --profile code installs code-context instead. Config: Setup writes .mcp.json. It offers to wire the sprint statusline into .claude/settings.json. Pass --defaults to skip the prompts. Run setup again: It switches to update mode: migrate (with automatic backup) and config repair. It never touches your data. --force renames the old database. It does not delete it. Restart your AI client: Claude Code (or any MCP client) loads the server from .mcp.json. Verify with get_project_status. Manual registration instead: see MANUAL SETUP in 04 USAGE. Launch the dashboard: npx code-context-dashboard ./context.db opens at http://localhost:3333 with live SSE updates. Watch and reindex: File watching and auto-reindex on save are on by default (derived from the indexed files). Pass a directory as the 4th argument only to override it, for example on a database with nothing indexed yet: npx code-context-dashboard ./context.db 3333 . Run your first sprint: Type /kickoff in Claude Code. The orchestrator walks you through vision -> discovery -> milestone -> epics -> tickets -> sprint -> implementation -> retro. It asks one question at a time. Smart resume lets you stop and continue later

bench-read-v3-dark.svg: Proof runs: Real agent numbers from proof runs on 2026-10-11, rescored and renormalized. "Saved" compares each arm with vanilla (no server); positive means fewer. Range = min .. max over repeats. Caveats: Small n, fixed fixtures (L1 sample project, L4/L6 this repo, I-tasks the generated fixture), one day. GLM caching: GLM caches tool definitions across sessions with no off switch, so its uncached counts leave out that prefix. Opus is a smoke check: n=2 per task and arm (one cold, one warm), no guided arm. The guided DeepSeek miss is an L6 timeout (300 s). Older runs: Agent runs before 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC told every arm to use the built-in file tools. They do not show the server in use

sprint-v3-dark.svg: Planning (1 day): Tickets assigned, velocity committed. Implementation (3 days): All tickets DONE or NOT_DONE, blockers resolved. Done (0.5 day): Retro findings recorded, QA verified. Rest (0.5 day): Automatic after retro. Order: Planning -> implementation -> done -> rest. Each phase has a gate check. Configurable: Change phases, durations and gates with update_sprint_config. QA gate (since 2.2): qa_verified needs commits with Why:/What:/How: body groups. Open-items gate (since 2.0): start_sprint and advance_sprint refuse while untriaged retro try_next findings or escalated discoveries exist. Override with acknowledge_open_items: true
